headline: Here’s How Much You Would Have Made Owning Tesla Stock In The Last 15 Years
summary: Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA) has outperformed the market over the past 15 years by 29.88% on an annualized basis producing an average annual return of 43.01%. Currently, Tesla has a market capitalization of $1.45 trillion.
